scientific_question: Can Hindsight 0.9.2 be reconstructed in a fresh project-owned Python 3.11 environment solely from the accepted routed wheelhouse, with every active locked distribution and runtime import independently checkable?
decision_informed: Whether a deterministic offline Hindsight runtime is eligible for an independent environment audit and then the frozen embedded-pg0 lifecycle.
scientific_evidence_role: Offline environment reconstruction design only; no model load, service, lifecycle, benchmark, superiority, comparison-table number, or SOTA claim is eligible.

prior_gates.required_future_evidence: A separately frozen audit execution must produce an independently TERMINAL_ACCEPTED wheelhouse-audit.json with an exact SHA-256.

acceptance: The future accepted wheelhouse audit record hash and terminal sentinels match the successor execution prefreeze.
All 199 wheel files still match the accepted audit path, route, byte size, and SHA-256 before installation.
The shared source Python remains byte-identical and is never modified.
The fresh environment is created with copied launchers and installs from only the two accepted local wheel directories.
All 199 target-marker-active locked distributions are installed at satisfying exact versions; extras are limited to venv bootstrap distributions and are fully inventoried.
pip check passes and Hindsight, Hindsight API/client/embed, pg0, and CPU torch imports pass using only the accepted execution-source overlay.
The evidence root retains commands, exit codes, timings, pip freeze, installed distribution inventory, record hashes, and one agreeing terminal sentinel.
authorization_gate: This design is not executable. After the wheelhouse is materialized and independently accepted, create a separate environment-execution prefreeze binding the exact wheelhouse-audit record SHA-256, fresh-root observations, free-space ceiling, process count, and the unchanged materializer hash.
failure: Any collision, source-Python drift, wheel/audit drift, attempted index access, missing or wrong package, pip-check/import failure, byte/time ceiling breach, or nonzero command seals TERMINAL_REJECTED and retains the partial environment and evidence root without in-place repair.
next_gate_after_acceptance: Independently revalidate package identities, offline imports, environment evidence, absence of background processes, and filesystem size; only then bind the accepted environment record into the Hindsight lifecycle-execution prefreeze.
prohibited_actions: executing without a successor prefreeze that binds an accepted wheelhouse-audit record hash
installing into or modifying the shared Python 3.11 environment
using an index, cache substitution, dependency resolution, source distribution, mutable requirement, or retry
installing the Hindsight source as a mutable package instead of using the accepted source overlay
loading either Hindsight model, starting pg0, binding a port, or calling an LLM
deleting or repairing a partial environment or failed evidence root in place
populating a comparison-table numeric cell or making a superiority/SOTA claim
